Title: Procurement Data Analyst
Description: Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Job Summary The Senior Data Analyst is an expert in the field of data who leverages their extensive experience to lead and execute complex data analysis projects. They are instrumental in designing sophisticated data models and analytics that inform strategic business decisions. With a mentorship role, they guide junior analysts through intricate data tasks and ensure the accuracy and reliability of data interpretations. Their collaborative efforts with various departments help to align data initiatives with organizational goals. The Senior Data Analyst’s ability to distill vast datasets into actionable insights makes them a valuable asset in any data-driven enterprise. Responsibilities Data Analysis Conduct data analysis to identify trends and insights Develop and maintain data models Create dashboards and reports to communicate findings Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze data for business decisions Data Management Oversee data collection, cleaning, and validation processes Ensure data accuracy and integrity Develop and maintain data governance policies Identify and implement data quality improvements Data Visualization Design and develop visualizations for data interpretation Utilize various tools and techniques to present data in a user-friendly and impactful manner Continuously improve and innovate data visualization techniques Data Strategy and Planning Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and objectives Develop data strategies to support business goals Identify and recommend new data sources and technologies Monitor and evaluate data processes and systems for efficiency and effectiveness Project Management Lead data projects from conception to completion Create project plans, timelines, and budgets Monitor and report project progress and risks Coordinate with team members to ensure project success High Impact Behaviors Continuous Professional Development: Professionals should be committed to lifelong learning, seeking out opportunities for self-improvement, and staying abreast of industry trends and best practices. Collaboration and Teamwork: Effective professionals understand the value of collaboration. They work well with others, contribute to team goals, and understand that diverse perspectives can lead to better solutions. Results-Driven Performance: High-performing professionals focus on delivering results. They set high standards for their own performance and are committed to achieving objectives efficiently and effectively. Qualifications A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field with at least 4 years experience or equivalent work experience that provides exposure to fundamental theories, principles, and concepts. Extensive experience in data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning. Proficiency in programming languages like Python, R, or MATLAB for data manipulation and analysis. Expertise in using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or D3.js. Strong understanding of engineering principles and processes. Project management skills to lead complex data initiatives. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Problem-solving mindset to tackle intricate engineering challenges using data-driven approaches. Continuous learning to stay updated with emerging technologies and methodologies in data science. Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

Title: Salesforce Quality Assurance Senior Engineer - Mexico
Description: Who You’ll Work With In our Salesforce business, we help our clients bring the most impactful customer experiences to life and we do that in a way that makes our clients the hero of their transformation story. We are passionate about and dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team, recognizing that diverse team members who are celebrated for bringing their authentic selves to their work build solutions that reach more diverse populations in innovative and impactful ways. Our team is comprised of customer strategy experts, Salesforce-certified experts across all Salesforce capabilities, industry experts, organizational and cultural change consultants, and project delivery leaders. As the 3rd largest Salesforce partner globally and in North America, we are committed to growing and developing our Salesforce talent, offering continued growth opportunities, and exposing our people to meaningful work that aligns to their personal and professional goals. Job Title: Salesforce Quality Assurance Lead Engineer Slalom is seeking a Salesforce Quality Engineer and test lead capable of delivering and leading testing activities on client projects and helping scale our Salesforce quality engineering practice. You will lead teams of quality engineers who will be performing both manual and automated testing on the Salesforce platform and ecosystem. You will be expected to work directly with internal senior leaders to help build and expand our quality engineering practice by developing thought leadership, best practices, training programs, point-of-views, new offerings, testing frameworks, and testing strategies. Responsibilities Lead software quality and testing activities on Salesforce projects of medium to large size and complexity. Manage full quality and testing teams through all phases of the project lifecycle. Develop overall quality and testing strategy for client projects. Help provide thought leadership and contribute to the development of quality engineering standards and methodologies at Slalom. Assess solution risk and assist the project team in prioritizing test efforts. Select and configure appropriate quality toolsets to manage project testing. Provide meaningful mentoring and advising to junior members of the practice. Perform responsibilities of quality engineering project team members from application testing to test strategy rollout when required. Manage quality engineering resources, assist with talent/recruiting activities, and help grow and mentor more junior resources. Qualifications Experience in software and testing lifecycle, inception through deployment. Experience in test strategy, test planning, test case design, and test execution. Experience with quality-related roles such as test lead, performance test engineer, automation test designer, test environment designer, and user acceptance test lead. Experience with UI test automation (e.g., Selenium, Provar, AccelQ, CRT, Tricentis). Experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, SoapUI, Fiddler). Passionate about quality engineering and the Salesforce ecosystem. Able to partner with clients to understand their organizational needs and recommend quality engineering solutions that add value to their business. Great verbal and written communication skills. About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.
